definitions.explanation: The part of the body between the neck and upper arm.

examples.english: To pat someone on the shoulder.

examples.japanese: {肩|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凝|こ}っている→凝る：08180_koru⟧。
⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肩|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せた→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I put the child on my shoulders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{肩|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くなった→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My shoulders started to hurt because I used the computer for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肩|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧{肩|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くなってきた→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I was walking with a heavy bag on my shoulder, and gradually my shoulder started to hurt.

notes:
{肩|かた} refers to the shoulder area of the body. It appears in many common expressions and idioms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肩|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凝|こ}る→凝る：08180_koru⟧: to have stiff shoulders (very common complaint in Japan)
- {肩|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to stand shoulder to shoulder; to be on equal footing
- {肩|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to take someone's side
- {肩|かた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷|に}→荷：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to feel relieved of a burden
- {肩|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to slump one's shoulders (in disappointment)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{肩書|かたがき}→肩書：17246_katagaki⟧: title, position
- ⟦{肩車|かたぐるま}→肩車：16181_kataguruma⟧: riding on shoulders (piggyback on shoulders)
- ⟦{肩幅|かたはば}→肩幅：27827_katahaba⟧: shoulder width

CULTURAL NOTE:
{肩|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凝|こ}る→凝る：08180_koru⟧ (stiff shoulders) is an extremely common ailment in Japan. {肩|かた}⟦たたき→たたき：noentry⟧ (shoulder tapping/massage) is a traditional way children show appreciation to parents.
